description:
Send the agent a message about a presentation (POST /api/v1/presentations/{id}/messages). Paid by actual usage.

request.text is a change request ("shorten slide 3", "another theme") or a question / discussion. The agent
decides from the text: it either answers and updates the presentation map without rebuilding the deck, or
rebuilds the deck when asked; result.version grows only when the deck changed, last_agent_message holds the
answer. Optional file_urls (up to 5 public HTTPS links or urls from upload_media, same formats and limits as
create_presentation) add new material to the running session. Answers 202 at once; follow it with get_presentation until awaiting_input.
It is refused with 409 while the agent is still working and for a failed or archived presentation, and with 402
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE when the balance is below the minimum (see estimate_presentation).
name: revise_presentation
